<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-PH">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Elevate Dental CHROME concept B, The Calm Shelf</title>

<!--
  ELEVATE DENTAL : CHROME TOURNAMENT, CONCEPT B "THE CALM SHELF"
  Stage (2) CHROME. BRAND-CARD, FEEL and SYSTEM are all stamped and LOCKED.

  WHAT THIS IS. One chrome concept: the five site-wide parts (desktop header,
  mega-menu panel, mobile drawer, the single closing CTA band, footer) composed on a
  small demo body so the chrome is judgeable in context. It links the LOCKED token
  API and the LOCKED structural sheet and reuses their vocabulary. It mints no
  colour: every value below resolves through a var(--ds-*).

  THE DESIGN PROBLEM. C1 fixes ELEVEN top-level nav items. Eleven labels plus a
  logo plus the pinned appointment control do not fit one bar at readable type at
  1101px. Measured: eleven labels are about 95 characters, which is roughly 630px of
  text at the 11px floor, plus minimum gaps, against about 615px of free track once a
  logo and a control have taken their share of a 1021px inner measure. The concept's
  answer is to split PRACTICAL from NAVIGATIONAL across two tiers:

    tier 1, THE UTILITY STRIP  the four real clinic numbers as tel: links, the hours
                               note, and the pinned "Book an Appointment" control.
                               Every way to REACH the clinic, on one rail.
    tier 2, THE SHELF          the logo and the eleven-item nav, alone on a taller
                               tinted shelf. The MAP of the site, on its own rail.

  With the control lifted onto the strip, the shelf's nav runs from just right of
  the logo to the gutter and distributes its own slack (space-between over a minimum
  gap), so the bar TIGHTENS itself between 1440 and 1101 instead of overflowing. An
  arc seam hangs off the shelf where the header meets the page.

  THE NAV IS C1's, EXACTLY. Eleven items, same labels, same order, in the desktop
  shelf AND in the drawer. That parity is gate G-CHROME-NAV and it is the exact
  drift that shipped on a previous build.

  BUDGETS THIS CONCEPT SPENDS, recorded so the body knows what is left:
    ARC SEAM   the structural sheet allows ONE arc per page. The chrome spends it at
               the header/page joint, so every other joint below is a flat colour
               step opened by the index rule, including the one into the .precta.
    DARK BAND  SPENT ONCE, on the .precta, and nowhere else. C7 allows the dark flip
               only as punctuation, "in one place, for one job (a single proof or
               conversion band)", and the closing conversion band is that job. The
               ladder therefore reads primary-soft strip, cool shelf, paper page,
               DARK .precta, warm footer: one deep beat between two light grounds,
               which is figure and ground rather than a dark site.
    CTA BANDS  exactly ONE, the .precta. Page bodies author zero.
-->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../elevatedental-tokens.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../elevatedental-structural.css">

<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   CHROME CONCEPT B : "THE CALM SHELF"
   Token-pure. No colour literal below this line: every colour, radius, shadow,
   duration and easing resolves through a var(--ds-*) from the locked sheet.
   Raw px survives only as a structural literal (a hairline, a control height, a
   media anchor), never as a colour.
   ========================================================================== */

/* --- the chrome's own layout values, all derived from the locked scale ----- */
:root{
  --ed-chrome-max: 1320px;   /* the shelf runs a step wider than the reading measure */
  --ed-util-h: 56px;         /* tier 1, the utility strip */
  --ed-shelf-h: 70px;        /* tier 2, the shelf */
  --ed-arc-h: 18px;          /* the seam where the header meets the page */
  --ed-header-h: calc(var(--ed-util-h) + var(--ed-shelf-h) + var(--ed-arc-h));
}
/* THE COLLAPSE. The desktop bar folds to the hamburger wherever it cannot fit.
   1100 is the anchor: a previous build collapsed only at 768 and overflowed 264px
   at 834. Everything from 1100 down runs the single compressed bar. */
@media (max-width: 1100px){
  :root{ --ed-util-h: 0px; --ed-shelf-h: 62px; --ed-arc-h: 14px; }
}

[hidden]{ display: none !important; }
body{ background: var(--ds-bg-surface); }
main{ padding-top: var(--ed-header-h); }
main > .kit-hero:first-child{ border-top: 0; }

/* ==========================================================================
   PART 1 : THE HEADER
   ========================================================================== */
.site-header{
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: var(--ds-z-sticky);
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface-2);          /* the shelf tint, and the arc's ground */
  transition: box-shadow var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.site-header.is-stuck{ box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-card); }

.ed-wrap{
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--ed-chrome-max);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--ed-gutter);
  min-width: 0;
}

/* --- tier 1 : THE UTILITY STRIP ------------------------------------------- */
.ed-util{
  height: var(--ed-util-h);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--ds-primary-soft);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
  transition: height var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
/* NAV-PATTERNS #8's sticky behaviour: the utility row retires on scroll and the
   nav shelf is what stays pinned. main's padding is fixed, so nothing jumps. */
.site-header.is-stuck .ed-util{ height: 0; border-bottom-color: transparent; }
.ed-util__in{
  height: var(--ed-util-h);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ds-space-md);
  min-width: 0;
}

.ed-tels{ display: flex; align-items: stretch; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; min-width: 0; }
.ed-tels li + li{ border-left: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline); }
.ed-tel{
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px 16px;
  min-height: 44px;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ed-tels li:first-child .ed-tel{ padding-left: 0; }
.ed-tel__c{
  font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ds-ink-soft);
  transition: color var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.ed-tel__n{
  font-family: var(--ds-font-mono); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--ds-ink-heading); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  transition: color var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.ed-tel:hover .ed-tel__n{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }
.ed-tel:hover .ed-tel__c{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }

.ed-util__end{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--ds-space-sm); margin-left: auto; min-width: 0; }
.ed-hours{
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: .02em;
  color: var(--ds-ink-soft); white-space: nowrap;
}
.ed-hours b{ display: block; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }
/* the pinned appointment control, compacted for the strip. Never a third weight:
   it is the same .kit-btn--primary the whole system uses. */
.ed-util .kit-btn{
  width: auto;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* --- tier 2 : THE SHELF ---------------------------------------------------- */
.ed-shelf{
  position: relative;
  height: var(--ed-shelf-h);
  /* the soft tint wash. Two radial washes over the cool ground, the same material
     move .kit-atmos makes in the body, so the shelf reads as a surface and not a bar */
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(64% 180% at 88% 0%, var(--ds-primary-soft) 0%, transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(46% 150% at 6% 100%, var(--ds-bg-warm) 0%, transparent 68%);
}
/* THE UNROLLED INDEX RULE along the shelf's top edge: minor graduations on a
   hairline, the brand's signature motif doing a structural job as the joint
   between the two tiers. */
.ed-shelf::before{
  content: "";
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 6px;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ds-primary) 0 1px, transparent 1px calc(100% / 48));
  opacity: .22;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ed-shelf__in{
  height: var(--ed-shelf-h);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ds-space-md);
  min-width: 0;
}

/* the logo lockup: the index ring beside the wordmark. No tagline here: the
   tagline is spent once, in the .precta, where it has room to be read. */
.ed-logo{
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  flex: 0 0 auto; min-width: 0;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.ed-logo__mark{ flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ed-logo__word{
  font-family: var(--ds-font-display); font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.012em;
  color: var(--ds-ink-heading); white-space: nowrap;
}
.ed-logo:hover .ed-logo__word{ color: var(--ds-primary-deep); }

/* THE NAV. Eleven items, one row, distributing their own slack. `gap` is the
   MINIMUM spacing and space-between spends whatever is left, so the bar tightens
   itself from 1440 down to 1101 rather than overflowing at some fixed width. */
.ed-nav{ flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; margin-left: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 40px); }
.ed-nav__list{
  display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; min-width: 0;
}
.ed-nav__item{ min-width: 0; }
.ed-nav__link{
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  padding: 7px 0;
  font-family: var(--ds-font-body);
  font-size: clamp(11px, .88vw, 13px);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: .005em;
  color: var(--ds-ink-heading);
  background: none; border: 0;
  text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer;
  transition: color var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
/* the hover mark is the card's bronze index bar at nav scale: it extends from the
   left rather than fading in, which is the one gesture this system uses for "open" */
.ed-nav__link::before{
  content: "";
  position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 0; height: 2px;
  background: var(--ds-accent);
  transition: width var(--ds-dur-slow) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.ed-nav__link:hover, .ed-nav__link[aria-expanded="true"]{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }
.ed-nav__link:hover::before, .ed-nav__link[aria-expanded="true"]::before{ width: 100%; }
.ed-nav__link.is-current{ color: var(--ds-primary-deep); }
.ed-nav__link.is-current::before{ width: 100%; background: var(--ds-primary); }
/* the mega caret, drawn not typed, so the accessible label stays exactly "Treatments" */
.ed-caret{
  display: block; width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--ds-accent-deep);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-accent-deep);
  transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg);
  transition: transform var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.ed-nav__link[aria-expanded="true"] .ed-caret{ transform: translateY(1px) rotate(-135deg); }

/* the arc seam where the header meets the page. The page ground RISES into the
   shelf, one bronze hairline riding the curve. This is the page's ONE arc. */
.ed-arc{ height: var(--ed-arc-h); margin-bottom: 0; }

/* the compressed-bar controls, off above 1100 */
.ed-cta-m, .ed-burger{ display: none; }

/* ==========================================================================
   PART 2 : THE MEGA PANEL
   ========================================================================== */
.ed-scrim{
  position: fixed; inset: 0; top: var(--ed-header-h);
  background: var(--ds-primary-deep);
  opacity: var(--ds-opacity-scrim);
  border: 0;
}
.ed-mega{
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 100%;
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface);            /* the arc's fill flows straight into it */
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
  box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-lift);
  max-height: calc(100vh - var(--ed-header-h));
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.ed-mega__in{ padding-block: var(--ds-space-lg) var(--ds-space-md); }
.ed-mega__grid{
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
  gap: var(--ds-space-lg);
}
.ed-mega__col{ min-width: 0; }
.ed-mlist{ list-style: none; margin: var(--ds-space-sm) 0 0; padding: 0; }
.ed-mlist li{ margin-top: 2px; }
.ed-mlink{
  display: block;
  padding: 7px 0;
  font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--ds-ink); text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out), padding-left var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.ed-mlink:hover{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); padding-left: 6px; }
.ed-mclinic{
  display: block; padding: 9px 0; text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
}
.ed-mclinic:last-child{ border-bottom: 0; }
.ed-mclinic b{ display: block; font-family: var(--ds-font-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--ds-ink-heading); }
.ed-mclinic span{ display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ds-ink-soft); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ed-mclinic:hover b{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }
.ed-mega__foot{
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--ds-space-sm) var(--ds-space-md);
  margin-top: var(--ds-space-md);
  padding-top: var(--ds-space-md);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
}
.ed-mega .kit-card{ height: 100%; }
.ed-mega .kit-btn{ width: auto; }

/* ==========================================================================
   PART 3 : THE MOBILE DRAWER
   ========================================================================== */
.ed-drawer{ position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: var(--ds-z-drawer); }
.ed-drawer__scrim{
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: var(--ds-primary-deep);
  opacity: var(--ds-opacity-scrim);
  border: 0;
}
/* THE DRAWER IS A FLEX COLUMN, and that is the whole anti-trap mechanic:
   head (fixed) / scroll region (flex:1 1 auto, min-height:0, overflow-y:auto) /
   foot (flex:0 0 auto). The foot is a SIBLING of the scroll region, never an
   overlay on top of it, so no nav row can be stranded underneath it. */
.ed-drawer__panel{
  position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: min(92vw, 384px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
  box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-lift);
}
.ed-drawer__head{
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--ds-space-sm);
  padding: 12px var(--ds-space-md);
  min-height: 62px;
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
}
.ed-close{
  position: relative;
  width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  background: none; border: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--ds-r-control);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.ed-close::before, .ed-close::after{
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 21px;
  width: 18px; height: 1px; background: var(--ds-primary);
}
.ed-close::before{ transform: rotate(45deg); }
.ed-close::after{ transform: rotate(-45deg); }
.ed-close:hover{ border-color: var(--ds-accent); }

.ed-drawer__scroll{
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  padding: var(--ds-space-md) var(--ds-space-md) var(--ds-space-lg);
}

/* the drawer LEADS WITH CLINIC CHOICE: a Manila patient picks a branch first */
.ed-pick{ margin: 0 0 var(--ds-space-md); padding-bottom: var(--ds-space-sm); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ds-primary); }
.ed-pick__list{ list-style: none; margin: var(--ds-space-sm) 0 0; padding: 0; }
.ed-pick__row{
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--ds-space-sm);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
}
.ed-pick__row:last-child{ border-bottom: 0; }
/* the row's whole height IS the link's padding, so the tap target is the row */
.ed-pick__name{ flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; text-decoration: none; padding: 14px 0; }
.ed-pick__name b{ display: block; font-family: var(--ds-font-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--ds-ink-heading); }
.ed-pick__name span{ display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ds-ink-soft); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ed-pick__tel{
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px;
  font-family: var(--ds-font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .04em;
  color: var(--ds-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline); border-radius: var(--ds-r-control);
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface-2);
  text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;
}
.ed-pick__tel:hover{ border-color: var(--ds-accent); color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }

/* the drawer nav: the SAME eleven labels, the SAME order as the shelf */
.ed-dnav{ list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.ed-dnav > li{ border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline); }
.ed-dnav__link, .ed-dnav__sum{
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--ds-space-sm);
  width: 100%;
  padding: 14px 0;
  min-height: 52px;
  font-family: var(--ds-font-body); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ds-ink-heading);
  text-decoration: none;
  background: none; border: 0; text-align: left;
  list-style: none; cursor: pointer;
}
.ed-dnav__sum::-webkit-details-marker{ display: none; }
.ed-dnav__link:hover, .ed-dnav__sum:hover{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }
.ed-dcaret{
  display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--ds-accent-deep);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ds-accent-deep);
  transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg);
  transition: transform var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
details[open] > .ed-dnav__sum .ed-dcaret{ transform: translateY(1px) rotate(-135deg); }
.ed-dlist{ list-style: none; margin: 0 0 var(--ds-space-sm); padding: 0 0 0 var(--ds-space-md); border-left: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); }
.ed-dlist a{
  display: block; padding: 9px 0; min-height: 40px;
  font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ds-ink-soft); text-decoration: none;
}
.ed-dlist a:hover{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }

/* the foot. flex:0 0 auto, a real sibling, so it never sits over the list. */
.ed-drawer__foot{
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: var(--ds-space-md);
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface-2);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
}
.ed-drawer__foot .kit-btn{ width: 100%; }
.ed-nap{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px var(--ds-space-sm); margin-top: 12px; }
.ed-nap a{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--ds-primary); text-decoration: none; }
.ed-nap a:hover{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); text-decoration: underline; }
.ed-nap span{ font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ds-ink-soft); }

/* ==========================================================================
   PART 4 : THE CLOSING CTA BAND  (.precta, the ONE band on any page)
   This is also the page's ONE dark punctuation. It carries .section--dark PAIRED
   with .surface-dark, which is the authoring form the structural sheet requires:
   the flip repoints the tokens for the whole subtree, so every object inside
   re-skins itself instead of only the band. The joint into it is a flat ground
   step, because the sheet turns the light-to-light hairline and contact ramp OFF
   into and out of the dark band, and the page's one arc is already spent above.
   ========================================================================== */
.precta .kit-actions{ margin-top: var(--ds-space-md); }
.precta__aside{
  padding: var(--ds-space-md);
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--ds-line);
  border-radius: var(--ds-r-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-card);
}
.precta__ring{ display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-sm); }

/* ==========================================================================
   PART 5 : THE FOOTER
   ========================================================================== */
.site-footer{
  background: var(--ds-bg-warm);
  padding-block: var(--ed-flow) var(--ds-space-lg);
}
.ed-fbrand{
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--ds-space-lg);
  padding-bottom: var(--ds-space-lg);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ds-primary);
}
.ed-fbrand__id{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--ds-space-sm); min-width: 0; }
.ed-fbrand__word{ font-family: var(--ds-font-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.014em; color: var(--ds-ink-heading); }
.ed-fbrand__say{ flex: 1 1 320px; min-width: 0; }
.ed-fcols{
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) minmax(0, 1.55fr);
  gap: var(--ds-space-lg);
  padding-block: var(--ds-space-lg);
}
.ed-fcol{ min-width: 0; }
.ed-flist{ list-style: none; margin: var(--ds-space-sm) 0 0; padding: 0; }
.ed-flist li{ margin-top: 4px; }
.ed-flist a{
  display: block; padding: 5px 0;
  font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ds-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--ds-dur-fast) var(--ds-ease-out);
}
.ed-flist a:hover{ color: var(--ds-accent-deep); text-decoration: underline; }
.ed-flist--tel a{ min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.ed-fsoc{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: var(--ds-space-sm); }
.ed-fsoc a{
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em;
  color: var(--ds-primary); text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline); border-radius: var(--ds-r-control);
  background: var(--ds-bg-surface);
}
.ed-fsoc a:hover{ border-color: var(--ds-accent); color: var(--ds-accent-deep); }
.ed-fbar{
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--ds-space-sm) var(--ds-space-md);
  padding-top: var(--ds-space-md);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ds-hairline);
}

(function(){

  var drawer = document.getElementById("drawer-root");
  var burger = document.getElementById("hamburger");
  var drawerClose = document.getElementById("drawer-close");
  var drawerScrim = document.getElementById("drawer-scrim");

  /* --- the mega panel ---------------------------------------------------- */
  function setMega(open){
    if(!mega || !megaTrigger) return;
    mega.hidden = !open;
    if(megaScrim) megaScrim.hidden = !open;
    megaTrigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  }
  if(megaTrigger){
    megaTrigger.addEventListener("click", function(){
      setMega(megaTrigger.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true");
    });
  }
  if(megaScrim) megaScrim.addEventListener("click", function(){ setMega(false); });
  document.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    if(!mega || mega.hidden) return;
    if(mega.contains(e.target) || (megaTrigger && megaTrigger.contains(e.target))) return;
    setMega(false);
  });

  /* --- the drawer -------------------------------------------------------- */
  function setDrawer(open){
    if(!drawer || !burger) return;
    drawer.hidden = !open;
    burger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
    burger.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu");
    document.body.style.overflow = open ? "hidden" : "";
    if(open){ setMega(false); }
  }
  if(burger) burger.addEventListener("click", function(){ setDrawer(drawer.hidden); });
  if(drawerClose) drawerClose.addEventListener("click", function(){ setDrawer(false); });
  if(drawerScrim) drawerScrim.addEventListener("click", function(){ setDrawer(false); });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    if(e.key === "Escape"){
      setMega(false);
      if(drawer && !drawer.hidden){ setDrawer(false); if(burger) burger.focus(); }
    }
  });

  /* --- EXCLUSIVE drawer accordions. The `name` attribute already does this in
     current browsers; this is the fallback, so the drawer can never grow to the
     both-open height in an engine that ignores it. ------------------------- */
  var accs = drawer ? drawer.querySelectorAll("details.ed-dacc") : [];
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(accs, function(d){
    d.addEventListener("toggle", function(){
      if(!d.open) return;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(accs, function(other){
        if(other !== d) other.open = false;
      });
    });
  });

  /* --- the sticky state: the utility row retires, the shelf stays --------- */
  function onScroll(){
    if(!header) return;
    if(window.pageYOffset > 80) header.classList.add("is-stuck");
    else header.classList.remove("is-stuck");
  }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  /* --- the scroll reveal latch, exactly as the structural sheet defines it:
     the class is added ONLY when scripting, IntersectionObserver and normal
     motion preference all hold, so nothing is ever hidden without it. ------ */
  var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  if("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce){
    document.documentElement.classList.add("js-rise");
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(en){
        if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add("is-in"); io.unobserve(en.target); }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px", threshold: 0.05 });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-rise]"), function(el, i){
      el.style.setProperty("--i", i % 6);
      io.observe(el);
    });
  }
})();
